Handy for bulk-adding a recurring group booking — e.g. a kindergarten course's weekly ice time — download the template, fill in one row per date, and import it back.

admin.slotQrDesc: Pick an exact zone, date, and time to generate a one-tap registration code — scanning it opens the sign-up form directly for that slot, with nothing else to pick. Good for open-ice / walk-in sessions.
admin.phoneQrDesc: Scanning it opens the phone's own dialer with the number prefilled — just tap to call. You can create several codes (e.g. for different purposes) and show any of them on the striedačka TV board as well.

rinkSchedule.title: Rink schedule
rinkSchedule.intro: A standing schedule of which team/group has the ice when — every entry blocks real ice, the same way a normal booking does.
rinkSchedule.notAuthorizedNotice: You don't have access to the rink schedule.
rinkSchedule.tvScreenHint: A public, no-scroll schedule display suited for an unattended screen (front desk, locker room hallway).
rinkSchedule.tvShortcutHint: Or type this short address on the TV's remote:
rinkSchedule.roomPlaceholder: Optional — can be filled in later
rinkSchedule.awayRoomPlaceholder: Only fill in for a match between two teams
rinkSchedule.noneFiltered: No entries match the current filter.
rinkSchedule.recurrenceForeverHint: Keeps {{count}} upcoming occurrences scheduled at all times — a new one is added automatically as each one passes, with no end date. Past occurrences stop showing in this list once they're over and are permanently deleted after 2 months.
rinkSchedule.confirmDelete: Delete this schedule entry? This also cancels the ice reservation it created.
rinkSchedule.informationalEventHint: Written into the schedule at exactly the given day and time, even if the ice is already occupied (by another event or every zone) — it doesn't create a real ice reservation, just an informational note. One-off only for now, can't be repeated.
rinkSchedule.confirmDeleteInformational: Delete this informational entry from the schedule?
rinkSchedule.confirmCancelOccurrence: Cancel just this one occurrence? The rest of the series stays unchanged.
rinkSchedule.slotUnavailable: This zone is already reserved for the selected time.
rinkSchedule.confirmReplace: This slot is already held by {{label}}. Cancel it and replace it with this new entry?
rinkSchedule.conflictNotice: Heads up: this slot is already held by {{label}}. Submitting will let you replace it.
rinkSchedule.conflictNoticeBooking: Heads up: this slot is already held by a customer booking and can't be replaced from here.
rinkSchedule.importHint: Upload a spreadsheet (or a plain .csv/.txt file with the same columns) to add many entries at once — one row per date, for a recurring entry use the form above instead. Required columns: Hala (rink number, e.g. 1 or 2), Nazov (name), Datum (date, dd.mm.yyyy), Cas (start time, 24h). Optional: Trvanie (duration in minutes — leave blank for 60), Satna (room), Ihrisko (which part of the ice — leave blank for the whole rink).
rinkSchedule.boardScanHint: Scan for the schedule on your phone
rinkSchedule.alternatingHint: Cycles between the current ice schedule and the free-ice-for-rent listing — meant for a screen at the players' bench (a different spot than the main hallway TV). Change the cycle speed with a URL parameter, e.g. ?interval=15 (seconds, default 10).

freeIce.intro: A list of open ice slots available to rent — also shown on the alternating TV screen (/rozvrh/strieda).

freeIce.replacesPublicScheduleWarning: Heads up: this list is now the ONLY source of what a customer sees and can book on /book. A rink/date with no entry here shows nothing on /book (the day is "closed").
freeIce.importHint: Upload a spreadsheet (or a plain .csv/.txt file with the same columns) to add several free-ice slots at once. Required columns: Hala (rink number, e.g. 1 or 2), Datum (date, dd.mm.yyyy), Od and Do (start/end time, 24h format). Optional: Zona (which part of the ice — "krajná tretina" / "stredná tretina", an exact zone name, or blank for the whole rink) and Cena (free text, e.g. "80 €").

tournaments.duplicateTeamName: A team named "{{name}}" already exists in this tournament.
tournaments.needAtLeastTwoTeams: Add at least 2 teams to generate a schedule.
tournaments.previewHint: Preview — {{count}} matches. Adjust the break between rounds below.
tournaments.byeHint: With this many teams, {{count}} teams will get a bye in the first round (advancing automatically).
tournaments.knockoutPreviewHint: Bracket preview — {{rounds}} rounds. Advancement fills in automatically once a result is recorded.
tournaments.breaksHint: Break after each round of matches — edit a specific gap to override the default.
tournaments.noDraws: A knockout match can't end in a draw.

tournaments.finishedBadge: Finished — you can still correct the score
tournaments.publicScreenHint: Scanning this QR code opens the public tournament overview, which can be displayed e.g. on a cafe screen — it updates automatically as you record scores below.
tournaments.pointsForWinHint: A draw is always worth 1 point, a loss 0 — only the points for a win are configurable (usually 3).

schemaOptionDesc.roundRobin: Every team plays every other team — works well with fewer teams, final standings come from the running table.
schemaOptionDesc.knockout: A loss means elimination — teams advance through a seeded bracket to the final, with byes where needed.
schemaOptionDesc.groups: A group stage first (tables), then the top finishers from each group advance into a knockout bracket.

tournaments.favoriteTeamNoMatches: No matches for this team yet.
tournaments.tvScreenHint: A fixed, no-scroll dashboard layout meant for an unattended screen (a TV, a lobby display) — standings/bracket, live scores, and the next matches, sized to fill the whole screen automatically.
tournaments.tvCodeHint: Or type this short code on the TV's remote instead of the full address:
tournaments.matchImportHint: For a tournament played entirely at another venue (e.g. your team travels to someone else's tournament) — upload a spreadsheet with every match at once instead of adding them one by one below. A row with a Group (A, B, ...) creates/matches its teams and feeds the live standings table. Leave Group blank for a placement/play-off row scheduled before the outcome is known — write "A5" for "5th place in group A", "W:label" / "L:label" for the winner/loser of another row (give that row a Label, e.g. "SF1", so others can reference it) — the real team name fills in automatically once it's decided. Any other text in Team A/B is kept exactly as typed.
